scope: Registration.registerProposal of software update proposals signed by a throwaway delegate key (deterministicKeyGen of a fixed seed in Main.hs), against a state of application versions and registered software proposals, and for two cases Interface.registerUpdate of a block's update payload (the proposal, a vote of its proposer for it, the block's endorsement): the verdict, the refusal's constructor and fields, and after an acceptance the registered software proposals (and, for a payload, the application versions and the number of confirmed proposals); no block, header or epoch rule is run

registration.note: registerProposal: proposer, signature, then the components, the protocol update before the software update (331-391); TooLarge built positionally as (maximum, size) (511-513); registerSoftwareUpdate: checkSystemTag of each key of the metadata in Map order, the duplicate, checkSoftwareVersion, svCanFollow (553-597)

systemTag.note: systemTagMaxLength 10 (67-68); checkSystemTag: T.length over it is SystemTagTooLong, then any non-isAscii character SystemTagNotAscii (113-117)

applicationName.note: checkApplicationName: T.length over 12 is ApplicationNameTooLong, then ApplicationNameNotAscii (113-123)

interface.note: registerUpdate: the proposal, the votes, the endorsement (244-258); registerVotes confirms and records the application version with its metadata (316-355)
